can_teleport_into_liquid.description: If set to true, the entity can teleport into blocks that contain liquids, such as water.

dark_teleport_chance.description: Modifies the chance that the entity will teleport if the entity is in darkness.

light_teleport_chance.description: Modifies the chance that the entity will teleport if the entity is in daylight.

max_random_teleport_time.description: Maximum amount of time in seconds between random teleports.

min_random_teleport_time.description: Minimum amount of time in seconds between random teleports.

on_teleport_sound.description: The level sound event which is played after a successful teleportation. Entities without a sound bound to this event play the default teleport sound.

projectile_filter.description: Conditions that determine which projectiles cause the entity to attempt to teleport. If omitted, all projectiles cause a teleport attempt.

random_teleport_cube.description: Entity will teleport to a random position within the area defined by this cube.

random_teleports.description: If true, the entity will teleport randomly.

target_distance.description: Minimum distance the entity needs to be from the target to start teleporting towards it.

target_teleport_chance.description: The chance that the entity will teleport between 0.0 and 1.0. 1.0 means 100%.

target_teleport_distance.description: The minimum and maximum distance the entity can teleport toward the target. Negative values teleport away from the target. Values need to be between -32 and 32.
target_teleport_distance.x-runtime-constraint-description: Check that the limits imposed on the range (minimum, maximum and maximum distance between values) are respected

target_teleport_offset.description: The maximum random offset, on each axis and in either direction, added to the teleport directional vector. The y offset is rounded down to whole blocks. Values need to be between 0 and 32.

teleports_on_projectile_hit.description: If true, the entity will attempt to teleport away from projectiles about to hit it.
